description: Renders a declarative JSON diagram into a visual representation. The input MUST conform to the DiagramInput schema.

aspectRatio.description: Frame the output to a target aspect ratio by padding (never cropping or scaling). 'auto' (default) picks a sensible ratio from the diagram type and direction; 'none' disables framing.

direction.description: Layout direction: Top-Bottom, Bottom-Top, Left-Right, Right-Left

label.description: Optional text label on the edge

groupId.description: If this node is inside a boundary/group (like a VPC), put the parent group node's ID here

icon.description: Optional identifier for a brand or tech icon (e.g., 'aws-lambda', 'react', or FontAwesome 'fas-user')

label.description: Text displayed on the node (keep it concise)

metadata.description: Additional structured data, such as 'fields' for tables or 'methods'/'attributes' for classes

standalone.description: Set true when this node is intentionally not connected by any edge (e.g. an account-wide service like IAM, logging, or another supporting concern). Renders with a distinct muted/dashed style so it reads as deliberate rather than a missed connection.

x.description: Explicit X coordinate (bypasses auto-layout if provided)

y.description: Explicit Y coordinate (bypasses auto-layout if provided)

routing.description: Edge routing style: orthogonal (bends), polyline (straight lines), splines (curves)

style.description: Visual style preset controlling shape geometry, spacing, and stroke weight (separate from theme colors). 'compact' (default) is dense with soft fills; 'clean' is the classic look; 'minimal' is outline-only; 'sketch' is hand-drawn.

customFontUrl.description: HTTPS URL to a custom .ttf font file

customIcons.description: Map of icon name to raw SVG string for custom brand icons

edgeLabelColor.description: Color of the text labels on edges (hex)

theme.description: A named preset ('light' | 'dark' | 'pastel' | 'mono') or a custom color theme object

title.description: A descriptive title for the diagram

type.description: The type of diagram to generate

messages.description: Ordered list of messages in chronological sequence

label.description: Description of the API call or action

source.description: ID of the participant sending the message (can be same as target for self-messages)

target.description: ID of the participant receiving the message

type.description: Sync (solid line), async (solid line, open arrow), or return (dashed line)

label.description: Display name of the actor or system

cx.description: X coordinate of the pie center (e.g. 400)

cy.description: Y coordinate of the pie center (e.g. 300)

data.description: Data points for the pie chart. Total values should equal 100.

color.description: Custom hex color for the slice (e.g. #ec4899)

explode.description: Offset radius to explode the slice outwards (e.g. 20)

legend.description: Show a color legend listing each slice

points.description: Data points plotted on the quadrant

left.description: Label for the left side of X axis

right.description: Label for the right side of X axis

bottom.description: Label for the bottom side of Y axis

top.description: Label for the top side of Y axis

dateFormat.description: Format of the dates, or 'generic' for numeric units

dependencies.description: Array of task IDs that must finish before this starts

duration.description: Duration if end is not provided

end.description: End date or generic numeric value

start.description: Start date or generic numeric value

branch.description: Name of the branch this commit belongs to

parents.description: Array of parent commit IDs. 2 parents indicate a merge.

kind.description: initial = start dot, final = end dot, composite = nested container

parent.description: id of the composite state this nests inside

events.description: Events that happened in this period

description.description: Short description shown under the label

parent.description: id of the boundary/system this nests inside

value.description: Leaf size; parent nodes sum their children

name: render_diagram
